title: Women's Marion Boat Shoe - Heritage Brown
description: The Marion Boat shoe is all about classic styling and comfort in interesting new colorways. We kept the Marion unlined for comfortable sockless wear all summer long. The white deck sole is siped for unparalleled grip on wet surfaces while the uppers are crafted using traditional moccasin techniques that make these shoes long lasting and comfortable from the moment you step into them. The Marion boat shoe is extremely lightweight, comfortable, flexible and a stylish alternative to other boat shoe brands making cheap replicas overseas. Genuine handsewn moccasin construction. Made in Maine, USA. Made to order.
